date-drill: Click Quarter next to Grain: the 16 month bars become 6 quarter bars
Click the Q2 2026 column: the range narrows to April–June and the grain steps down to Month
Click ↑ All dates to go back to every month
fiscal-calendar: Read the Calendar quarters: Jul–Sep 2026 is Q3 2026 at $234k
Read the highlighted row: Jul–Sep 2026 is now FY27 Q1 at $234k
as-of-anchor: Read the chart on Today with Last 30 days: some of the 30 days come after the newest order, so they are empty
Click Newest order: the anchor query finds 23 Sep 2026 and a chip shows ⚓ As of 23 Sep 2026
Read the range next to the chips: 25 Aug – 23 Sep 2026, 30 days that all have data
Click Last 7 days or Last 90 days: each range still ends on 23 Sep
partial-period: Read the last bar, Sep 2026: it is hatched
Read the note under the chart: Sep 2026 has 23 of 30 days, data through 23 Sep
Click Mark incomplete periods to turn it off: the last bar now reads as a drop
Click Quarter next to Grain: the last quarter is marked the same way
period-compare: Click vs previous month: a dashed line for the month before appears over the bars
Click vs same month last year: a green line for last year appears
Read the numbers under the chart for Sep 2026: −26% vs Aug 2026 and −31% vs Sep 2025
Click another month to read its two changes
custom-compare: Pick H1 2026 in the B menu: each country gets a grey A bar and a violet B bar
Type your own dates in the date boxes to compare any two ranges
to-date: Click YTD: a dashed line climbs through each year and resets in January
Click Trailing 3 months: a green line shows the rolling 3-month total
Click a month to read its revenue, YTD and trailing 3 months under the chart
hierarchy-drill: Click Customer 184: the table lists that customer's 13 orders
Read the breadcrumb, All regions › APAC › Australia › Customer 184, and the KPIs and trend on the right, which follow the path
Click APAC in the breadcrumb to climb back
adhoc-breakdown: Right-click the Software bar, or just click it
Pick Status in the Break down Software by menu
Read the new panel, Software by status: completed, shipped and cancelled
underlying-records: Read the KPIs: $1,283,053 from 1,500 orders, and revenue by month below
Click the May 2026 column: the KPIs narrow to $88,378, and a drawer opens with that month's orders, newest first
Click Load more: the next 25 of its 101 orders load
Click Close: the KPIs go back to all months
drillthrough: Read the Cohort Heatmap app: it opens with Country = Japan
metric-switch: Read the bars on Revenue: Services leads
Click Units: the bars reorder and Hardware leads with 2,775 units, with Leave out cancelled on
Read the hint: the count of queries run does not change, because switching the metric only redraws
dimension-switch: Read Revenue by country with Group by set to Country
Pick Status in Group by: the bars rebuild as completed, shipped and cancelled
Pick Category to see a third grouping
sort: Read the table: it is sorted by Revenue, the AQL default
Click the Orders header: the server re-sorts by orders, most first
Click Load 25 more: page 2 continues the new order
Click Orders again to flip the direction, or AQL order to go back
top-n: Click Top 3: Australia, Singapore and Germany stay
Read the Other (3) bar: it holds the remaining $509k
Read the hint under the bars: they still add up to $1.28M
pivot: Read the grid on $: countries down the side, categories across the top
Click % of country: each row now adds up to 100%
Read the Australia row: Services is 46% of Australia
Click % of category to make each column add up to 100% instead
totals: Read the Share of category column: Gizmo is 61% of Hardware
Read the Hardware subtotal row under the Hardware products
Read the Grand total row at the bottom: $1,283,053, or $1.28M
Pick a country in Country: the subtotals, shares and total all follow
percent-of-total: Read the share on each bar: Australia has 24.4% and Japan 9.2%
Click Software next to Category: the shares change, and still add up to 100%
cumulative-moving: Click Running total: a line climbs over the bars, on its own scale at the right
Click 3-month average: a dashed line smooths the monthly bars
Hover a month to read its revenue, 3-month average and running total under the chart
drill-path: Click APAC in Regions, then Australia: the drill path reads All regions › ↓ APAC › ↓ Australia
Click ↑ Up a level: you're back in Countries in APAC, and the path adds ↑ APAC
Click Singapore: the path keeps every step, … › ↑ APAC › ↓ Singapore
Click ↓ Australia in the path: Australia's customers come back, with Revenue here at $313,397
row-actions: Read the table: each customer row ends with Open in CRM ↗, Email and View orders →
Hover Open in CRM on Customer 184: its URL is https://crm.example.com/accounts/184, built in the query
Click it: the app shows the URL, and says the sandbox won't let it open a tab
Click View orders → on Customer 184: their latest orders open below, starting with #803 on 23 Aug 26 for $4,243
